sloka: बुद्धिः वैरम् विना हन्तुम् राक्षसान् दण्डक आश्रितान् ।अपराधम् विना हन्तुम् लोको वीर न कामये ॥३-९-२५॥
transliteration: buddhiḥ vairam vinā hantum rākṣasān daṇḍaka āśritān ।aparādham vinā hantum loko vīra na kāmaye ॥3-9-25॥

translations.english: Contact with the weapon has led to this in the past. Like contact with fire, it leads man to destruction. I say this out of my love and reverence for you as a reminder and not as an instruction.
